# WPEssential Bank Transfer Matcher Pro for WooCommerce

Development draft. Submission and publication are pending release verification.

Development preview of the separate add-on. Requires a compatible active Free edition.

- Separate add-on activation and Free dependency checks.

Activate WooCommerce before installing the edition ZIP. Use the WordPress Plugins screen to upload and activate the ZIP. Activate the Free edition before Pro. Pro requires Free API `>=1.0.0 <2.0.0`.
